svg.aria-label: FixMyCity architecture diagram, with legend and caption, animated.
svg.title: FixMyCity — Architecture Diagram

g.title: Cloud Build — two triggers, auto build and deploy, on every push to main
Cloud Run — fixmycity (public): oRPC API + Better Auth
Genkit Flow — analyzeReport: isCivicIssue, category, issueLabel, severity, description, imageIsClear
Gemini 3.6 Flash — vision, structured output, tool calling
Cloud SQL — Postgres: PresubmitDraft, Ticket, User/Session

foreignObject.div: Blue = the request path through GCP infrastructure, numbered in sequence. Purple = the AI layer (Genkit calling Gemini). Grey = deploy-time, not part of a citizen’s request — GitHub and Cloud Build sit under Admin, and Cloud Build fans out to both Cloud Run services on every push to main. The second purple line, Cloud SQL back up to Genkit, is the correction feedback loop: past tickets where a citizen overrode the model are replayed into the next classification. Every connector’s dashes flow toward its arrowhead, live, in the direction data actually moves.
